conclusions: Concealed/draw geometry is again stable on this second real original match: all 51 reviewed truth slots were detected with no misses or extras across four checkpoints.
Raw template identity is substantially stronger on this Sep-26 match than on the Oct-3 diagnostic: 51/51 reviewed crops rank the correct class first, including yellow M6 appearances.
The fixed Runtime 0.82 gate, not raw Top-1 identity, is the immediate whole-hand blocker on this batch: S2 is consistently ranked correctly but rejected around 0.68-0.70.
Exact-source exclusion shows the known Sep-26 gold-skin-only M6 evidence materially affects yellow-Gold acceptance, so product-realistic and source-filtered metrics must remain separate.

There are zero wrong accepted tiles in either run, but only 1/4 product-realistic whole hands and 0/4 exact-source-filtered whole hands are fully accepted; this batch therefore does not justify lowering the 0.82 threshold or promoting a classifier.
